proc runConfiguredSession(deck: StreamDeck; shouldStop: proc (): bool;
                          onKey: proc (event: StreamDeckKeyEvent);
                          readPage: proc (previousGeneration: int64): JsonNode;
                          onReady: proc () = nil;
                          options = defaultPlayerOptions()) {.
    ...raises: [ValueError, Exception, Exception, IOError],
    tags: [RootEffect, ReadIOEffect, WriteIOEffect], forbids: [].}
Own the device until stopped: show the newest page from readPage, animate it, and report key edges. readPage returns nil when unchanged or {generation, menu, keys}; nil readPage uses the builtin numbered page. onReady runs after every key of a new generation is on the device. Stopping restores the logo; the session is always closed, and a close failure after another error is logged so the original error propagates. Source   Edit
